name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company focused exclusively on the state of Nevada, one of the world's premier gold mining jurisdictions. The company holds multiple exploration-stage gold projects in Nevada, including Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar. Nevada Canyon Gold is in the exploration stage and completed a reverse circulation drill program in 2025, with results released in early 2026.
